description: This file defines the implementation of the LiveSignalPub interface, providing methods to instantiate and access published streams of commands, events, and signals within an actor system for real-time messaging in a distributed pub/sub architecture.

classes.name: LiveSignalPubImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the LiveSignalPub interface, managing distributed publishers for commands, events, and signals, with a static factory method to instantiate based on actor context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of LiveSignalPubImpl with configured distributed publishers, using the provided actor context.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Returns the distributed publisher for commands.

methods.name: event
methods.description: Returns the distributed publisher for events.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Returns the distributed publisher for signals/messages.

methods.name: getTopicExtractor
methods.description: Private static method to retrieve a topic extractor based on the streaming type.
